metadata.description: Starter Claude setup for a church and school IT team: onboarding with the org's AI rules, and IT admin skills for student activity review, Google Workspace account lifecycle, UniFi review, and automation.

plugins.name: onboarding
plugins.description: Start here. /welcome sets up the working folder, writes the org AI rules as an ambient CLAUDE.md, interviews the person and builds their first real project; org-guide answers 'is this allowed?'; migrate-project moves a claude.ai Project or mega-prompt into a folder; build-brand-voice writes the voice file from real samples.

plugins.name: it-admin
plugins.description: IT admin skills with guardrails built in: student-activity-review (GoGuardian and Workspace audit exports), account-lifecycle (end-of-year cleanup in reversible stages), unifi-review (read-only RF and VLAN review), automation-port (Power Automate flows to scheduled scripts, with where-it-runs and credential placement).
